desc:
Play as a giant kaiju, destroy cities, and Battle For Dominance against the military and other giant monsters! Can you conquer the Kaiju Universe?

Update 7.2.0: A whole new world! Rebuilt cities that crumble, forests that fall, a living seafloor and new water. Plus boss cutscenes, rare Alpha kaiju, weather events, VIP Missions, a nuclear meltdown, a full trait rework and smoother performance!

🦖 - Unlock dozens of powerful giant Kaijus with unique combat styles
🏢 - Go against the human militaries as you destroy cities
⚔️ - Battle enemy bot and player Kaijus for victory
⭐️ - Level up and invest skill points to maximize your kaiju's power
🗺️ - Explore an open sandbox world infested with ravenous Wyrmites

❗️ Join the Prometeo Games group to unlock a free kaiju!

Tags: Kaiju, Monster, Creature, PVP, Animals, Battle, Fantasy
